A dynamic yoga class linking breath & movement to build strength, flexibility & mindfulness. Weather permitting, we practice on the rooftop!

About this Event

A dynamic yoga class linking breath & movement to build strength, flexibility & mindfulness. Weather permitting, we practice on the rooftop!
Join us for a dynamic, flowing yoga class that connects breath with movement through creative sequences designed to build strength, flexibility, and mindfulness. Experience the serenity of practicing on the Etage rooftop, offering stunning views of downtown, weather permitting. All levels welcome! This is part of a weekly class series.
Please be sure to fill out the guest waiver before class by clicking the link here: https://lo.ls/Y7dTxok
In the case of rain or unsafe conditions, class will either be moved indoors or canceled. Final weather calls will be made via email by 3pm for evening classes and 8am for morning classes.
If class moves indoors, you’re always welcome to still join us—or you can opt for a class credit within 1 hour of the update.
If class is canceled due to weather, instructor illness, or any other unforeseen circumstances, your booking will automatically be converted into a class credit (no refunds). Credits must be used within 60 days and are valid for classes of equal or lesser value.
For smooth day-of updates, please include your email at booking.
I will also share updates on my instagram story—follow @simplysophyoga to stay in the loop.
Per Etage Athletic Club's policy, all guests of the facility must be 18+.
BYOM: Please remember to bring your own yoga mat to class for a comfortable and enjoyable practice. If you don’t have a mat, a towel will work as an alternative :)
Parking & Arrival Info
Parking is available at Etage’s garage on Stanwix St — bring your ticket in for up to 3 hours of validation!
When you arrive:
